comment: DESIGN.md § Analysis, Judge checks (c): the negation and partial probes, transcribed verbatim from its table. rule + repo say which question, key and notes the answer is judged against.

probes.answer: A signer who loses eligibility is not removed and the request is never auto-cancelled; they just fail the permission check when they respond, and only the editor cancelling unblocks it.
A signer who loses eligibility is automatically removed from the request, and if no signers remain it is auto-cancelled.
Editing is never locked by a signature request; the tab stays editable while a request is open.
Computing budget summaries never writes anything, however long since the last visit.
Removing a member deletes only the membership row; nothing they created is deleted.
If no entry exists the role has the default permission, `none`.
Names are unique ignoring case, so `Food` and `food` collide and the rename throws `DuplicateCategoryName`.
Date-range filters include the start date and exclude the end date.
The interrupted period is kept as a partial period and evaluated against its target prorated to its shortened length.
Once no signer is still pending the request resolves accepted, even if one signer declined.
Import keeps the pending SMS entries and resets the SMS scan point.
Deleting a project removes its row from the database, and its reads return 404.
Weeks start on Monday and months on the 1st.
A background scan runs only if the permission is already granted and a scan point exists, never prompts, and scans never overlap.
